         1                 P R O C E E D I N G S

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       The Senate will please come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       recite with me the Pledge of Allegiance to our

         6       Flag.

         7                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         8       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       In the absence of clergy, may we all bow our

        11       heads for a moment of silence.

        12                  (Whereupon, the assemblage

        13       respected a moment of silence.)

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       Thank you.

        16                  Senator Klein.

        17                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        18       is there a proclamation from the Governor at

        19       the desk?

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Yes, Senator Klein, there is a proclamation

        22       here at the desk.

        23                  The Secretary will read.

        24                  THE SECRETARY:    "I hereby amend



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5687



         1       the proclamation issued on the first day of

         2       July, two thousand nine, pursuant to the power

         3       vested in me by Article IV, Section 3 of the

         4       Constitution, convening the Senate of the

         5       State of New York in Extraordinary Session, at

         6       the Capitol, in the City of Albany, on the

         7       fifth day of July, two thousand nine, to

         8       change the time for such Extraordinary Session

         9       from three o'clock p.m. to six o'clock p.m.

        10                  "Given under my hand and the Privy

        11       Seal of the State in the City of Albany this

        12       third day of July in the year two thousand

        13       nine, by the Governor, David A. Paterson."

        14                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        15       The proclamation having been read, the Senate

        16       is in extraordinary session.

        17                  Senator Klein.

        18                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        19       can you please recognize Senator Skelos.

        20                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        21       Senator Skelos.

        22                  SENATOR SKELOS:    Thank you,

        23       Senator Stewart-Cousins.

        24                  As I've stated before, the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5688



         1       designation of a presiding officer should be

         2       made by Senator Espada or myself pursuant to

         3       the vote which took place on June 8th.

         4       Accordingly, we do not recognize that you are

         5       the appropriate designated presiding officer.

         6                  And in fact, we are here by court

         7       order indicating that the Senate should

         8       convene at the call of the Governor into

         9       extraordinary session.

        10                  Therefore, I'd like to move that

        11       the Senate adjourn this special session

        12       sine die.

        13                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        14       Thank you, Senator.

        15                  Senator Klein.

        16                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

        17       will you please recognize Senator Ruth

        18       Hassell-Thompson for a brief announcement.

        19                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        20       Senator Hassell-Thompson.

        21                  SENATOR HASSELL-THOMPSON:    Thank

        22       you, Madam President.

        23                  Immediately following this session

        24       there will be a meeting of the Senate Majority



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         5689



         1       in Room 332.

         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

         3       Thank you, Senator.

         4                  Senator Klein.

         5                  SENATOR KLEIN:    Madam President,

         6       I move that we do not take up any legislative

         7       activity today and we adjourn the special

         8       session sine die.

         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT STEWART-COUSINS:

        10       Thank you, Senator.

        11                  There will be a meeting of the

        12       Majority Conference in Room 332 immediately,

        13       and we adjourn this extraordinary session

        14       sine die.

        15                  (Whereupon, at 6:08 p.m., the

        16       Senate adjourned.)
